title: The Mad Ghoul
description:
S1
A mad scientist (George Zucco) turns his assistant (David Bruce) into a zombie as part of a plan to steal his assistant's lover (Evelyn Ankers).

title: Man-Made Monster
description:
S1
A mad scientist (Lionel Atwill) makes an electric man (Lon Chaney Jr.) who glows and must wear a rubber suit.

title: The Monster and the Girl
description:
S1
A mad scientist creates a monster when he transplants the brain of an executed murderer into the body of an ape.

title: Monster on the Campus
description:
S1
A professor turns into a Neanderthal killer after injecting himself with the blood of an ancient fish.

title: The Mummy
description:
S1
An Egyptian mummy (Boris Karloff) searches Cairo for the girl (Zita Johann) he thinks is his long-lost princess.

title: The Mummy's Curse
description:
S1
Shipped to Louisiana, mummy Kharis and his princess roam the bayou.

title: The Mummy's Ghost
description:
S1
A 3000-year-old limping mummy (Lon Chaney) seeks his reincarnated princess (Ramsay Ames) in a Midwestern college town.

title: The Mummy's Hand
description:
S1
Archaeologists defile the tomb of mummified Kharis, who was buried alive for falling in love with an Egyptian princess.

title: The Mummy's Tomb
description:
S1
An old archaeologist recalls the mummy Kharis, now at large in New England.

title: Night Creatures
description:
S1
Pirate Captain Clegg (Peter Cushing), an English vicar by day, leads ghostly mounted smugglers by night.

title: Night Monster
description:
S1
A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.

title: Phantom of the Opera
description:
S1
An acid-scarred composer (Claude Rains) rises from the Paris sewers to boost his favorite opera understudy's (Susanna Foster) career.
